Title: Ersilia Compound Embeddings
Description: Bioactivity-aware molecular representation built by Ersilia, condensing a compound into 1024 features. A prototypical network of the kind introduced with FS-Mol was trained on Grover and Mordred descriptors to learn an embedding shaped by assay outcomes rather than structure alone, used to embed a reference library of around two million ChEMBL molecules, and then distilled into a small network that maps ECFP fingerprints straight onto those embeddings. That last step makes the descriptor cheap enough for routine screening. Individual dimensions are not interpretable.
Interpretation: 1024 bioactivity-aware features condensing a molecule for use as input to downstream models.
